versions.changelog: Added verifiable source: homepage and repository fields now point to github.com/Cskar10/booking-manager. Full source code publicly auditable.

Security: removed login/access details field from onboarding form — credentials never collected through chat. Added explicit instruction that agent must refuse credential input via chat and direct to admin for secure env config.

Added full metadata declaration: all required/optional env vars listed with descriptions, network endpoints documented with polling frequency, security guidance (least privilege, scoped accounts, app passwords, credential rotation). Addresses VirusTotal review findings about undeclared credentials and missing registry metadata.

Security: removed all executable shell commands (curl, psql) from skill files. Replaced with descriptive patterns and API references. No shell injection vectors remain. All credential handling described via environment variable references only.

Security hardening: all credentials now use environment variables instead of plaintext. SMTP passwords, DB tokens, API keys reference ${ENV_VAR} patterns. Removed raw credential placeholders from shell command examples. Credentials stored in openclaw.json env block, never in workspace files.
Updated onboarding form: added voice receptionist fields (greeting, tone, escalation contact). Removed personal/client-specific references — all examples now generic.

Added first-run onboarding: form-paste primary flow with step-by-step fallback. Agent detects missing config, prompts customer to paste completed onboarding form, parses and writes to TOOLS.md automatically. Includes onboarding form template (references/onboarding-form.md) for emailing to customers before setup.

Added automated reminder emails 24h before appointments. Includes configurable templates (cancel/reschedule options are per-business), booking_reminders tracking table, queries for all data sources (Turso, PostgreSQL, Google Sheets), and reschedule workflow updated to clear old reminders.

Initial public release of booking-manager.

- AI-powered assistant connects to any booking system (SQL, APIs, Google Sheets, webhooks).
- Manage bookings and notifications directly via phone (Telegram, WhatsApp, etc.).
- Owner can confirm, reschedule, or delete appointments conversationally.
- Automatically sends customer emails with calendar invites.
- Provides summarized schedule queries and enforces booking locks to prevent double bookings.
